title: Depopulation and Aging Villages After 1990
grammar: Privative and deficit postposition: híján ('for lack of / in the absence of')
goal: I can analyze the causes and consequences of post-1990 rural depopulation in Hungary.
I can use the privative postposition híján to express structural lack and causal absence.
I can discuss tiny villages (aprófalvak), village caretakers, and demographic aging in B2 Hungarian.
